descriptor: Korean skincare for professional programs and home use
about: TONEVER is a Korean skincare brand for professional programs and home use. According to the company, its approach draws on more than twenty years of practice at Tonup Aesthetic, specialist training and feedback from aesthetic treatment rooms.

Our philosophy centers on the skin's natural balance. We connect this approach with natural cycles and attention to the foundations of skincare: selecting raw materials, gentle processing and comfortable formulas. Our materials identify three principles: stability, clean beauty and sustainability. These are stated development priorities, rather than product certifications.

We pay attention to ingredient origins, processing methods and application formats. Our professional programs use two-component systems: a freeze-dried ampoule mixed before application, and a two-ampoule routine applied in sequence. The home care line includes a foaming toner, ampoules, a barrier care cream and a finishing cream for a more even-looking tone.

For partners, we offer professional skincare programs, training, application protocols and range development. Discussions about specific products, documents and supply are handled through Teranova. Formulas, labeling and permitted product claims are checked for the relevant market.

products.name: THE PAMIN
about: A professional system combining freeze-dried Black Signature with liquid Black Enhancer. We describe it as intensive care for skin hydration, firmness and appearance. The catalog shows the dry component in a 500 mg vial and the liquid in a 7 ml vial; the presentation shows a set of three pairs of vials.

The contents of Black Enhancer are poured into the Black Signature vial immediately before use and shaken until uniform. In our formula description, we list PDRN, peptides, hydrolyzed collagen, niacinamide and bisabolol.

products.name: LUMILOOK
about: A two-step professional program with Signature and Highlighter ampoules. The presentation shows ten vials for the first step and ten for the second. We associate the line with care for radiance, a visibly even tone and skin firmness.

The Brand Proposal lists Abelmoschus manihot extract, peptides, Sodium DNA, hyaluronic acid and hydrolyzed collagen. PSM technology is presented as part of the formulation approach. This information reflects the manufacturer's description.

products.name: REBELOOK
about: A two-step ampoule program from the 2026 catalog. Gold Signature and Highlighter are presented as separate components. We position the program as care for the skin's appearance, radiance and even-looking tone.
According to the catalog instructions, Gold Signature is applied first and allowed to absorb, followed by Highlighter as the finishing step. The two ampoules are applied in sequence.

products.name: READY BOOSTER
about: Repair Ready Toner De Rose Bubble Booster is a 200 ml foaming toner with a pump. It is intended as the first skincare step after cleansing. Its airy texture and rose water define the product; we describe it as hydrating care that prepares the skin for subsequent products.

The Brand Proposal lists AQUA TECA 1000T, COOLIF, BIO Marine Summer, BIORAN EX Infla Care and CeraPlex 5. The catalog instructions advise spreading two to three pumps over the skin and gently patting with the palms until absorbed.

products.name: AXIS AMPOULE
about: A 100 ml ampoule product for home care. The presentation describes it as a multi-ingredient formula for skin that looks hydrated and well cared for. The bottle has a dropper.

We list NMN, NAD, a five-peptide complex, a 12GF complex, five types of ceramides, Sodium DNA, sodium hyaluronate and panthenol. This list describes the composition according to the presentation. Detailed directions and a full INCI list are not provided in the supplied spread.

products.name: 72K FILM AMPOULE
about: A 50 ml ampoule for home care. We describe a texture that leaves a moisturizing film and position the product as care for dryness and the skin's appearance. The number 72K is part of the product name, rather than a promise about how long a result lasts.

The presentation lists Abelmoschus manihot flower extract, lavender water, tranexamic acid, madecassoside, centella and panthenol. According to the catalog, the product is applied after toner; an additional layer can be applied to dry areas as needed. It is presented for morning and evening care, including before makeup.

products.name: LUMENIQ CREAM
about: A 100 ml home care cream in a tube. The presentation associates the line with barrier care, hydration and skin that looks well cared for. Its texture and format are intended for the cream step of a skincare routine.
We list a five-ceramide complex, cholesterol, fatty acids, ectoin, Anemarrhena asphodeloides root extract, adenosine, sodium hyaluronate and tocopherol.

products.name: NUDE FIXER
about: Tone-Up Finish Cream is a 30 ml finishing cream in a pump bottle. In the presentation, its purpose is associated with a visibly more even tone and a smoother, radiant-looking complexion. It is a cosmetic finishing step for skincare.
We list Abelmoschus manihot flower extract, a nine-peptide complex, Sodium DNA and Ceramide NP. The product is presented separately from the professional ampoule programs.

products.name: AURORA SERUM
about: In the Brand Proposal, AURORA SERUM is described as a hydrolyzed collagen serum for hydrating care. Centella leaf water, centella components and aloe leaf extract are also listed.

The presentation shows a stylized silhouette in place of a photograph of the finished packaging. Volume, launch date and availability for supply have not been confirmed. No such details are therefore claimed; this description reflects the product concept presented in the materials.
